import { classIcon } from "/src/ui/class-icons.ts";
import { bloodlineTabs } from "/src/ui/bloodline-tabs.ts";

// Cut 30 §3 — the town on the camp (docs/TOWN.md): the scene (render/town.ts) in the well, a DOM hit target over everything one can
// tap (≥ 44 px, a hidden label for tests and screen readers), the markers (≤ 3: a sword over the forge when a kit step is affordable,
// a coin over the bank when a night's interest came in, a `!` rune over a building not yet opened), the staked plot's trigger on tap,
// and the building bar (the console's command card: one tile per building standing, in build order; tile and building open the same
// panel and share the badge). Day 0 is a camp — the mouth (tap = send), the tent (the hero), the crate (the pack); nothing else taps.
import "/src/town.css";
import "/src/legible.css";
import { createTownView, townState, BUILDINGS } from "/src/render/town.ts";
import { h, replace } from "/src/ui/dom.ts";
import { decorationSrc, icon } from "/src/ui/skin.ts";
import { kitAffordable } from "/src/ui/forge.ts";
import { openWindow as openSheet, closeAllSheets } from "/src/ui/sheet.ts";
import { tile, paintFace } from "/src/ui/frame.ts";
import { audio } from "/src/audio.ts";
import { questShown } from "/src/ui/quest.ts";
import { nextPill, nodeIcon, openWorks } from "/src/ui/works.ts";
import { townGraveyard } from "/src/ui/feats.ts";
import { townCrier } from "/src/ui/crier.ts";
import { openChronicle } from "/src/ui/chronicle.ts";
import { openRuns } from "/src/ui/runs.ts";
import { openLooks } from "/src/ui/look.ts";
import { classList, classUnlockReason } from "/src/ui/unlocks.ts";
import { CLASS_VERBS } from "/src/engine/classes.ts";
import { classSkillLadder } from "/src/ui/class-skills.ts";
import { renderClassTree } from "/src/ui/class-tree.ts";
import { renderClassStyles, classStyleName } from "/src/ui/class-styles.ts";
import { legacyBar, legacyNext, legacyNextText, renderLegacy } from "/src/ui/legacy.ts";
import { kwHost, detailHost, openTip, closeTip } from "/src/ui/tips.ts";
import { HOME_BUILDINGS, buildingDetails, buildingName } from "/src/ui/building-help.ts";
/** docs/TOOLTIPS.md: a building's tip (long-press / hover; its tap stays its panel) */
const HIT_TERM = (/* copy:none */ {
	crate: "pack",
	blacksmith: "forge",
	kennel: "kennel",
	bank: "bank",
	board: "quest",
	chest: "chest",
	worker: "worker"
});
/* copy:label */
const LABEL = {
	mouth: "Delve",
	tent: "hero",
	crate: "Loadouts",
	blacksmith: "forge",
	kennel: "companions",
	bank: "savings",
	staked: "next plot",
	board: "quest board",
	chest: "chest",
	worker: "next worker"
};
/* copy:label */
const BUILD_NAME = {
	house: "house",
	blacksmith: "forge",
	kennel: "kennel",
	bank: "bank"
};
/** a building's tile on the bar: its id (the old console ids, kept: tests and badges key on them), icon and word */
/* copy:button */
export const BUILDING_TILE = {
	blacksmith: {
		id: "forge",
		icon: "forge",
		label: "forge",
		glyph: "⚒"
	},
	kennel: {
		id: "party",
		icon: "party",
		label: "companions",
		glyph: "🐾"
	},
	bank: {
		id: "bank",
		icon: "gold",
		label: "savings",
		glyph: "$"
	}
};
/** the buildings standing, in build order (null: a lineage with no town on the wire — the old console reveal stands) */
export const townBuilt = (L) => L.town ? L.town.buildings.map((b) => b.id).filter((id) => BUILDINGS.includes(id)) : null;
const KEY = (L) => `idlever.town.${L.seed ?? 0}`;
function load(L) {
	try {
		const s = localStorage.getItem(KEY(L));
		return s ? JSON.parse(s) : null;
	} catch {
		return null;
	}
}
function save(L, s) {
	try {
		localStorage.setItem(KEY(L), JSON.stringify(s));
	} catch {}
}
/** a building's panel opened (its `!` rune goes) */
/** Cut 120 §10: the town target a worker's post stands at (`WorkerPost.post` / `WorkNode.post`). */
const postTarget = (post) => post ?? "mouth";
/** Cut 120 §7/§10: the next worker's mark — his chore's count by hand and the hours to his fallback (`forge 2/3 · or 30h`), from the
*  core's `Works.next_worker` node (`progress`, `eta_h`); none once he is lit (his post carries his price) or with no count. */
export function nextWorkerMark(L) {
	const W = L.tree, n = W?.next_worker ? W.nodes.find((x) => x.id === W.next_worker) : undefined;
	if (!n || n.state === "done" || n.state === "lit" || !n.progress) return null;
	return {
		id: n.id,
		name: n.name,
		post: n.post,
		text: /* copy:callout */ `${n.chore ?? ""} ${n.progress}${n.eta_h ? ` · or ${n.eta_h}h` : ""}`.trim()
	};
}
export function markOpened(L, id) {
	const s = load(L) ?? {
		seen: [],
		opened: []
	};
	if (!s.opened.includes(id)) {
		s.opened.push(id);
		save(L, s);
	}
}
export function renderTown(app, hooks) {
	const el = h("div", { class: "town" });
	const hits = h("div", { class: "town-hits" });
	const helpLabels = h("div", { class: "town-building-labels" });
	const actorHits = h("div", { class: "town-actor-hits" });
	const delveFaces = h("div", {
		class: "town-delve-faces",
		"aria-label": /* copy:label */ "Delving heroes"
	});
	const actorButtons = new Map();
	let actorKey = "", choosingActor = 0;
	const chooseActor = async (id, watch, anchor) => {
		const token = ++choosingActor;
		if (!app.lineage.hero_slots?.some((s) => s.id === id)) return;
		closeTip();
		closeAllSheets();
		if (!await app.selectBloodline(id) || token !== choosingActor) return;
		const slot = app.lineage.hero_slots?.find((s) => s.id === id);
		if (!slot || app.lineage.selected_bloodline !== id) return;
		closeAllSheets();
		if (watch && slot.state === "live") app.go({ kind: "watch" });
		else openHero(app, anchor.isConnected ? anchor : null);
	};
	const helpButtons = new Map();
	const buildingId = (id) => {
		const actual = id === "tent" ? "house" : id === "staked" ? state?.staked?.id : id;
		return HOME_BUILDINGS.includes(actual) ? actual : null;
	};
	let building = false;
	const buildPlot = () => {
		const plot = state?.staked;
		if (building || !plot?.ready || !app.engine.buildTown) return;
		building = true;
		tag.setAttribute("aria-busy", "true");
		void app.mutate(
			() => app.engine.buildTown(plot.id),
			/* copy:callout */
			"build",
			false,
			{ saveBeforePaint: true }
		).finally(() => {
			building = false;
			tag.setAttribute("aria-busy", "false");
		});
	};
	const inspectPlot = () => {
		const plot = state?.staked;
		if (!plot) return;
		if (plot.ready && app.engine.buildTown) {
			buildPlot();
			return;
		}
		openSheet(() => h("div", { class: "sheet-body plot-preview" }, ...buildingDetails(app.lineage, plot.id)));
	};
	const tag = h("div", {
		class: "town-tag num",
		hidden: true,
		"aria-live": "polite",
		onclick: inspectPlot,
		onkeydown: (e) => {
			const k = e;
			if (k.key === "Enter" || k.key === " ") {
				k.preventDefault();
				inspectPlot();
			}
		}
	});
	const plotDetails = () => {
		const plot = state?.staked;
		return plot ? buildingDetails(app.lineage, plot.id) : [];
	};
	detailHost(tag, plotDetails);
	const foundation = h("div", {
		class: "town-foundation",
		hidden: true,
		"aria-hidden": "true"
	});
	// Presentation-only vector: an empty foundation and four stakes, no house silhouette.
	foundation.innerHTML = "<svg viewBox=\"0 0 104 64\" xmlns=\"http://www.w3.org/2000/svg\"><path class=\"chalk\" d=\"M12 32 52 12 92 32 52 52Z\"/><path class=\"stake\" d=\"M12 32V22 M52 12V2 M92 32V22 M52 52V42\"/><path class=\"stake-cap\" d=\"M8 20h8v4H8z M48 0h8v4h-8z M88 20h8v4h-8z M48 40h8v4h-8z\"/></svg>";
	const plotArt = decorationSrc("house_plot_v2");
	if (plotArt) foundation.append(h("img", {
		src: plotArt,
		alt: "",
		draggable: "false",
		onload: () => foundation.classList.add("painted"),
		onerror: () => foundation.classList.remove("painted")
	}));
	// Cut 30.5: the `next` pill rides the scene's top-left (the home screen's one goal); a tap opens the works on its node
	const pill = nextPill(app, (node, at) => openWorks(app, node, at));
	kwHost(pill.el, "next");
	// c30-legible (the owner, a new player: "I didn't understand why there were new buildings"): a building's arrival names what raised
	// it (`first gold home → blacksmith`, the core's trigger), once, over the town while it stands up; its target glows the while
	const arrival = h("div", {
		class: "town-arrival num",
		"aria-live": "polite"
	});
	// Cut 118 §8: the crier, top right (the pill's opposite), crying the last absence's notable acts
	const crier = townCrier(app);
	// Cut 118 (owner amendment §4): the graveyard at the scene's foot, left — a stone per fallen heir (the newest few), epitaphs on hover
	const yard = townGraveyard(app);
	el.append(hits, helpLabels, actorHits, delveFaces, foundation, tag, arrival, pill.el, crier.el, yard.el);
	let arrivalTimer = 0;
	const view = createTownView(el);
	let chestOpenUntil = 0, chestTimer = 0;
	// the store: what this viewer has seen built (a building first seen goes up: scaffold → built) and opened (its rune goes)
	let store = load(app.lineage);
	// (an old save's first camp shows its town standing: no scaffold on everything)
	if (!store) {
		store = {
			seen: townBuilt(app.lineage) ?? [],
			opened: townBuilt(app.lineage) ?? []
		};
		save(app.lineage, store);
	}
	// the absence's parties: the report just read (once per absence)
	const ab = app.lastAbsence && !app.lastAbsence.played ? app.lastAbsence : null;
	if (ab) ab.played = true;
	const absence = ab?.report ?? null;
	let state = null;
	const btns = new Map();
	let sending = false;
	let tagTimer = 0;
	function kitInfo() {
		const n = kitAffordable(app.lineage);
		const price = (app.lineage.kit ?? []).filter((k) => k.next?.affordable).map((k) => k.next.price).sort((a, b) => a - b)[0];
		return {
			n,
			price
		};
	}
	function paint() {
		const L = app.lineage;
		const s0 = load(L) ?? store;
		const previousState = state;
		const previousHome = state?.home;
		state = townState(L, absence, {
			seen: s0.seen,
			opened: s0.opened,
			kit: kitInfo(),
			absenceNew: !!absence,
			board: questShown(L),
			chestOpen: performance.now() < chestOpenUntil
		});
		view.setState(state);
		if (previousHome === false && state.home) hooks.resident?.(0);
		// seen now (a re-mount does not raise it again)
		const built = state.buildings.map((b) => b.id);
		const fresh = built.filter((b) => !s0.seen.includes(b));
		if (fresh.length) save(L, {
			...s0,
			seen: [...new Set([...s0.seen, ...built])]
		});
		targets();
		paintActors();
		pill.paint();
		pill.el.hidden = !state.home || !L.tree;
		crier.paint(!!state.home);
		yard.paint(!!state.home);
		if (previousState) {
			const constructed = fresh.filter((id) => !previousState.buildings.some((b) => b.id === id));
			if (constructed.length) arrive(constructed);
		}
	}
	function paintActors() {
		const slots = app.lineage.hero_slots ?? [];
		const key = JSON.stringify(slots.map((s) => [
			s.id,
			s.heir,
			s.class,
			s.look,
			s.hero_name,
			s.name,
			s.state,
			s.live?.depth,
			s.live?.run_id,
			s.live?.activity
		]));
		for (const slot of slots) {
			const button = delveFaces.querySelector(`[data-delving-hero="${slot.id}"]`);
			if (!button) continue;
			button.title = `${slot.hero_name || slot.name} · ${heroPresence(slot).text}`;
			const depth = button.querySelector(".town-delving-depth");
			if (depth) depth.textContent = slot.live ? `D${slot.live.depth}` : "…";
		}
		if (key === actorKey) return;
		actorKey = key;
		if (actorHits.querySelector(".kw-open") || delveFaces.querySelector(".kw-open")) closeTip();
		actorButtons.clear();
		actorHits.replaceChildren();
		delveFaces.replaceChildren();
		for (const slot of slots) {
			const name = slot.hero_name || slot.name;
			const away = slot.state === "live";
			const button = h("button", {
				class: away ? "town-delving-hero" : "town-home-hero",
				"data-home-hero": away ? undefined : slot.id,
				"data-delving-hero": away ? slot.id : undefined,
				"data-heir": slot.heir,
				"aria-label": `${name} · ${away ? "Watch delve" : "Hero details"}`,
				title: `${name} · ${heroPresence(slot).text}`,
				onclick: (e) => {
					let id = slot.id;
					const pointer = e;
					if (!away && pointer.detail > 0) {
						const townBox = el.getBoundingClientRect();
						let distance = Infinity;
						for (const candidate of actorButtons.keys()) {
							const r = view.actorRect(candidate);
							if (!r) continue;
							const d = Math.hypot(pointer.clientX - townBox.left - r.x - r.w / 2, pointer.clientY - townBox.top - r.y - r.h / 2);
							if (d < distance) {
								distance = d;
								id = candidate;
							}
						}
					}
					void chooseActor(id, away, e.currentTarget);
				}
			});
			detailHost(button, () => {
				const current = app.lineage.hero_slots?.find((s) => s.id === slot.id);
				return current ? [h("div", { class: "kw-tip-head" }, current.hero_name || current.name), h("div", { class: "kw-tip-gloss" }, heroPresence(current).text)] : [];
			});
			if (away) {
				const face = h("span", {
					class: "town-delving-face",
					"aria-hidden": "true"
				});
				paintFace(face, slot.class, 36, slot.look);
				button.append(face, h("span", { class: "town-delving-depth num" }, slot.live ? `D${slot.live.depth}` : "…"));
				delveFaces.append(button);
			} else {
				button.append(h("span", { class: "vh" }, name));
				actorButtons.set(slot.id, button);
				actorHits.append(button);
			}
		}
		layoutActors();
	}
	function layoutActors() {
		for (const [id, button] of actorButtons) {
			const r = view.actorRect(id);
			button.hidden = !r;
			if (!r) continue;
			const w = Math.max(44, r.w), height = Math.max(44, r.h);
			Object.assign(button.style, {
				left: `${Math.round(r.x + r.w / 2 - w / 2)}px`,
				top: `${Math.round(r.y + r.h / 2 - height / 2)}px`,
				width: `${Math.round(w)}px`,
				height: `${Math.round(height)}px`
			});
		}
		const cave = view.rectOf("mouth");
		if (cave) Object.assign(delveFaces.style, {
			left: `${Math.round(Math.max(6, Math.min(el.clientWidth - delveFaces.offsetWidth - 6, cave.x + cave.w / 2 - delveFaces.offsetWidth / 2)))}px`,
			top: `${Math.max(6, Math.round(cave.y + 4))}px`
		});
	}
	view.onActors(layoutActors);
	const offActorLive = app.onLive(() => {
		if (el.isConnected) {
			paint();
		}
	});
	/** c30-legible: the arrival's beat — `first gold home → blacksmith` (≤ 4 words + the arrow) — and the eye drawn to the building */
	function arrive(ids) {
		const T = app.lineage.town;
		const parts = ids.map((id) => ({
			id,
			why: T?.buildings.find((b) => b.id === id)?.trigger ?? ""
		}));
		replace(arrival, ...parts.flatMap((p, i) => [
			i ? h("br") : "",
			p.why ? `${p.why} ` : "",
			p.why ? h("span", { class: "arrow" }, "→ ") : "",
			h("b", null, p.id)
		]));
		arrival.dataset.arrived = ids.join(" ");
		arrival.dataset.why = parts.map((p) => p.why ? `${p.why} → ${p.id}` : p.id).join(" | ");
		arrival.classList.add("show");
		for (const id of ids) btns.get(id)?.classList.add("arrived");
		clearTimeout(arrivalTimer);
		arrivalTimer = window.setTimeout(() => {
			arrival.classList.remove("show");
			for (const id of ids) btns.get(id)?.classList.remove("arrived");
		}, 4600);
	}
	/** the hit targets: one button per thing one can tap, over its sprite (≥ 44 px), its label hidden */
	function targets() {
		const s = state;
		if (!s) return;
		const fresh = app.lineage.best_depth === 0 && !app.lineage.runs?.length;
		const want = [
			...s.home ? [
				{
					id: "mouth",
					plot: "mouth"
				},
				{
					id: "tent",
					plot: "house"
				},
				...fresh ? [] : [{
					id: "crate",
					plot: "crate"
				}]
			] : [],
			...s.buildings.map((b) => ({
				id: b.id,
				plot: b.id
			})),
			...s.board ? [{
				id: "board",
				plot: "board"
			}] : []
		];
		// Cut 30.5: the chest taps while it holds a haul (drawn, closed and empty, it is no surface); the lit node's greyed worker opens the works
		if (s.chest?.state === "full") want.push({
			id: "chest",
			plot: "chest"
		});
		if (s.workers.some((w) => w.lit)) want.push({
			id: "worker",
			plot: "worker"
		});
		// the staked plot shows from day 0; it taps (its trigger) once the first building stands — day 0 keeps its four surfaces
		if (s.staked && (s.home || s.stage >= 1 || s.staked.ready)) want.push({
			id: "staked",
			plot: "staked"
		});
		for (const [id, b] of btns) if (!want.some((w) => w.id === id)) {
			b.remove();
			helpButtons.get(id)?.remove();
			helpButtons.delete(id);
			btns.delete(id);
		}
		// Cut 120 §10: the next worker's count and fallback on his post (`forge 2/3 · or 30h`) while no hire is lit — one marker, inside the
		// budget (≤ 3 with the scene's own); a post with no target here (its building not standing) shows it at the mouth
		const nw = nextWorkerMark(app.lineage), lit0 = s.workers.some((x) => x.lit);
		const nwAt = nw && !lit0 && s.markers.length < 3 ? want.some((x) => x.id === postTarget(nw.post)) ? postTarget(nw.post) : want.some((x) => x.id === "mouth") ? "mouth" : undefined : undefined;
		for (const w of want) {
			let b = btns.get(w.id);
			const label = w.id === "staked" && s.staked?.ready ? `Build ${BUILD_NAME[s.staked.id] ?? s.staked.id}` : w.id === "mouth" && app.lineage.live ? "Watch run" : LABEL[w.id] ?? w.id;
			if (!b) {
				b = h("button", {
					class: `town-hit hit-${w.id}`,
					"data-building": w.id,
					"aria-label": label,
					onclick: (e) => tap(w.id, e)
				}, h("span", { class: "vh" }, label));
				if (buildingId(w.id)) detailHost(b, () => buildingDetails(app.lineage, buildingId(w.id)));
				else if (HIT_TERM[w.id]) kwHost(b, HIT_TERM[w.id]);
				btns.set(w.id, b);
				hits.appendChild(b);
			}
			const homeId = buildingId(w.id);
			if (homeId) {
				let help = helpButtons.get(w.id);
				if (!help) {
					help = h("button", {
						class: "town-building-info",
						"data-building-info": w.id,
						onclick: (e) => {
							e.stopPropagation();
							openTip(e.currentTarget);
						}
					});
					detailHost(help, () => buildingDetails(app.lineage, buildingId(w.id)));
					helpLabels.append(help);
					helpButtons.set(w.id, help);
				}
				help.setAttribute("aria-label", `${buildingName(homeId)} information`);
				if (help.dataset.homeId !== homeId) {
					help.dataset.homeId = homeId;
					replace(help, h("span", { class: "town-building-name" }, buildingName(homeId)), h("span", {
						class: "town-info-glyph",
						"aria-hidden": "true"
					}, "i"));
				}
				help.dataset.state = w.id === "staked" ? s.staked?.ready ? "ready" : "locked" : "built";
			}
			b.setAttribute("aria-label", label);
			b.title = label;
			b.querySelector(".vh").textContent = label;
			// markers ride their building's target (one surface, the same panel)
			const mk = s.markers.filter((m) => m.at === w.id);
			// the lit worker carries his price (`$40` · `free`), the chest the porter's count (`2/3`)
			const lit = w.id === "worker" ? s.workers.find((x) => x.lit) : undefined;
			if (lit) mk.push({
				at: "chest",
				kind: "coin",
				label: lit.price ? `$${lit.price}` : /* copy:label */ "free"
			});
			b.dataset.worker = lit?.id ?? "";
			const holder = b.querySelector(".town-markers") ?? b.appendChild(h("span", { class: "town-markers" }));
			replace(holder, ...mk.map((m) => h("span", {
				class: `town-marker mk-${m.kind}`,
				"data-marker": m.kind
			}, icon(m.kind === "sword" ? "v_attack" : m.kind === "coin" ? "gold" : "alert", m.kind === "sword" ? "⚔" : m.kind === "coin" ? "$" : "!"), m.label ? h("b", { class: "num" }, m.label) : "")));
			if (nw && nwAt === w.id) holder.appendChild(h("span", {
				class: "town-marker mk-next",
				"data-marker": "next",
				"data-node": nw.id,
				title: nw.name
			}, nodeIcon(nw.id, nw.name), h("b", { class: "num" }, nw.text)));
			b.dataset.markers = [...mk.map((m) => m.kind), ...nw && nwAt === w.id ? ["next"] : []].join(" ");
			const cnt = w.id === "chest" && s.chest?.need ? `${s.chest.count ?? 0}/${s.chest.need}` : "";
			const ce = b.querySelector(".town-count");
			if (cnt) {
				if (ce) ce.textContent = cnt;
				else b.appendChild(h("span", { class: "town-count num" }, cnt));
			} else ce?.remove();
		}
		// c30-legible: the staked plot always wears its tag — what it becomes and what raises it (`kennel · first tame`), not only on tap
		if (s.staked && (s.home || s.stage >= 1 || s.staked.ready)) {
			const ready = s.staked.ready;
			const buildIcon = s.staked.id === "house" ? "forge" : BUILDING_TILE[s.staked.id]?.icon ?? "forge";
			replace(tag, ready ? icon(buildIcon, "⚒") : null, h("span", { class: ready ? "build-copy" : "" }, h("span", { class: "build-title" }, ready ? h(
				"span",
				{ class: "build-ready" },
				/* copy:button */
				"Build",
				" "
			) : null, h("b", null, ready ? BUILD_NAME[s.staked.id] ?? s.staked.id : LABEL[s.staked.id] ?? s.staked.id)), ready ? h(
				"small",
				{ class: "dim" },
				/* copy:label */
				"Free"
			) : null), !ready && s.staked.trigger ? h("span", { class: "dim" }, ` · ${s.staked.trigger}`) : null);
			tag.hidden = false;
			tag.dataset.next = s.staked.id;
		} else tag.hidden = true;
		tag.classList.toggle("build-marker", s.staked?.ready === true);
		if (s.staked?.ready && app.engine.buildTown) {
			tag.setAttribute("role", "button");
			tag.tabIndex = 0;
		} else {
			tag.setAttribute("role", "button");
			tag.tabIndex = 0;
		}
		layout();
	}
	function layout() {
		const s = state;
		if (!s) return;
		for (const [id, b] of btns) {
			const wk = id === "worker" ? state?.workers.find((x) => x.lit) : undefined;
			const r = view.rectOf(id === "staked" ? "staked" : id === "chest" ? "chest" : id === "worker" ? `worker:${wk?.id ?? ""}` : id);
			if (!r) {
				if (helpButtons.get(id)) helpButtons.get(id).hidden = true;
				b.hidden = true;
				continue;
			}
			b.hidden = false;
			const help = helpButtons.get(id);
			if (help) {
				help.hidden = false;
				const width = help.offsetWidth;
				Object.assign(help.style, {
					left: `${Math.max(6, Math.min(el.clientWidth - width - 6, r.x + r.w / 2 - width / 2))}px`,
					top: `${Math.max(6, Math.min(el.clientHeight - 44, id === "staked" && !s.staked?.ready ? r.y + r.h + 8 : r.y - 44))}px`
				});
			}
			// ≥ 44 px each way, centred on the sprite (a building's box trimmed to its body: the roof's sky is not the building)
			const readyPlot = id === "staked" && s.staked?.ready === true;
			const cx = r.x + r.w / 2, by = r.y + r.h;
			const size = plotSize(cx);
			const w = readyPlot ? size.w : Math.max(44, r.w * (id === "mouth" ? .6 : id === "chest" || id === "worker" ? 1 : .86)), hh = readyPlot ? size.h : Math.max(44, r.h * (id === "mouth" ? .7 : id === "chest" || id === "worker" ? 1 : .8));
			Object.assign(b.style, {
				left: `${Math.round(cx - w / 2)}px`,
				top: `${Math.round(by - hh + (hh > r.h ? (hh - r.h) / 2 : 0))}px`,
				width: `${Math.round(w)}px`,
				height: `${Math.round(hh)}px`
			});
		}
		if (!tag.hidden) placeTag();
		foundation.hidden = state?.staked?.ready !== true;
	}
	view.onLayout(() => {
		layout();
		layoutActors();
	});
	function plotSize(cx) {
		const w = Math.min(164, Math.max(44, 2 * Math.min(cx - 8, el.clientWidth - cx - 8)));
		return {
			w,
			h: Math.max(44, w * 108 / 164)
		};
	}
	function placeTag() {
		const r = view.rectOf("staked");
		if (!r) {
			tag.hidden = true;
			return;
		}
		const ready = state?.staked?.ready === true, cx = r.x + r.w / 2;
		const size = plotSize(cx), cy = r.y + r.h / 2;
		if (ready) Object.assign(foundation.style, {
			left: `${Math.round(cx)}px`,
			top: `${Math.round(cy)}px`,
			width: `${size.w}px`,
			height: `${size.h}px`
		});
		const half = tag.offsetWidth / 2;
		const tagCx = Math.max(half + 8, Math.min(el.clientWidth - half - 8, cx));
		const height = tag.offsetHeight;
		const defaultBottom = ready ? cy + size.h / 2 + 12 + height : r.y - 6;
		const clampBottom = (bottom) => Math.max(height + 8, Math.min(el.clientHeight - 8, bottom));
		// A ready plot label must not cover another building's tap target. Scene
		// geometry stays fixed; try the nearby space above/below the plot first.
		const candidates = [...new Set([
			clampBottom(defaultBottom),
			clampBottom(cy - size.h / 2 - 12),
			clampBottom(height + 8),
			clampBottom(el.clientHeight - 8)
		])];
		const targets = [...btns.entries()].filter(([id, b]) => id !== "staked" && !b.hidden).map(([, b]) => ({
			x: Number.parseFloat(b.style.left) + b.offsetWidth / 2,
			y: Number.parseFloat(b.style.top) + b.offsetHeight / 2
		}));
		const score = (bottom) => targets.reduce((n, p) => {
			const dx = Math.max(0, Math.min(tagCx + half, p.x + 22) - Math.max(tagCx - half, p.x - 22));
			const dy = Math.max(0, Math.min(bottom, p.y + 22) - Math.max(bottom - height, p.y - 22));
			return n + dx * dy;
		}, 0);
		const bottom = candidates.reduce((best, candidate) => score(candidate) < score(best) ? candidate : best, candidates[0]);
		tag.classList.toggle("marker-above", bottom <= cy);
		tag.style.setProperty("--build-anchor-offset", `${cx - tagCx}px`);
		Object.assign(tag.style, {
			left: `${Math.round(tagCx)}px`,
			top: `${Math.round(bottom)}px`
		});
	}
	function tap(id, e) {
		view.poke();
		const b = btns.get(id);
		const L = app.lineage;
		if (id === "mouth") {
			hooks.send();
			return;
		}
		if (id === "chest") {
			void openChest(b);
			return;
		}
		if (id === "worker") {
			openWorks(app, b.dataset.worker || undefined, b);
			return;
		}
		if (id === "staked") {
			const s = state?.staked;
			if (!s) return;
			if (s.ready && app.engine.buildTown) {
				buildPlot();
				return;
			}
			// the next building and what raises it (`kennel · first tame`): always shown (c30-legible); a tap flashes it
			replace(tag, h("b", null, LABEL[s.id] ?? s.id), s.trigger ? h("span", { class: "dim" }, ` · ${s.trigger}`) : "");
			tag.hidden = false;
			placeTag();
			tag.classList.add("flash");
			clearTimeout(tagTimer);
			tagTimer = window.setTimeout(() => {
				tag.classList.remove("flash");
			}, 1200);
			inspectPlot();
			return;
		}
		const marker = e.target?.closest?.(".town-marker");
		if (marker?.dataset.marker === "sword" && id === "blacksmith") {
			void buyKit();
			return;
		}
		if (BUILDINGS.includes(id)) {
			markOpened(L, id);
			paint();
		}
		if (id === "tent") hooks.hero(b);
		else if (id === "crate") hooks.open("loadout", b);
		else if (id === "kennel") hooks.open("party", b);
		else if (id === "blacksmith") hooks.forge(b);
		else if (id === "bank") openBank(app, b);
		else if (id === "board") hooks.quest(b);
	}
	/** the sword marker: one tap buys the cheapest kit step the purse can pay (the check-in's spend) */
	async function buyKit() {
		const lad = (app.lineage.kit ?? []).filter((k) => k.next?.affordable).sort((a, b) => a.next.price - b.next.price)[0];
		if (!lad || !app.engine.buyKit) return;
		const ok = await app.mutate(
			() => app.engine.buyKit(lad.slot),
			/* copy:callout */
			"kit"
		);
		if (ok) audio.cue("unlock");
	}
	/** Cut 30.5: the chest's tap — the lid flips, the coins arc to the purse (quick: ~0.5 s), the purse counts up (juice.ts), the porter's
	*  count moves (the core's `openChest`; the porter's chore). */
	async function openChest(b) {
		if (!app.engine.openChest || (app.lineage.tree?.chest ?? 0) <= 0) return;
		const gold = app.lineage.tree.chest;
		const flew = coinsFly(b, gold);
		chestOpenUntil = performance.now() + 1500;
		paint();
		clearTimeout(chestTimer);
		chestTimer = window.setTimeout(() => {
			if (el.isConnected) paint();
		}, 1550);
		audio.cue("exit_bank");
		if (flew) await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 380));
		await app.mutate(() => app.engine.openChest());
	}
	function send(after) {
		if (sending) return;
		sending = true;
		const reduce = document.documentElement.dataset.juice === "off" || matchMedia?.("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches;
		void (reduce ? Promise.resolve() : view.walkIn(650)).then(() => {
			after();
		});
		setTimeout(() => {
			sending = false;
		}, 2500);
	}
	paint();
	return {
		el,
		view,
		paint,
		send,
		anchorOf: (id) => btns.get(id) ?? null,
		dispose: () => {
			offActorLive();
			closeTip();
			clearTimeout(tagTimer);
			clearTimeout(chestTimer);
			clearTimeout(arrivalTimer);
			view.dispose();
		}
	};
}
/** Cut 30.5: coins arc from `from` to the top bar's purse (juice on; a handful by the sum, staggered, ~0.5 s each); false when juice is off. */
export function coinsFly(from, gold) {
	if (document.documentElement.dataset.juice !== "on" || typeof Element.prototype.animate !== "function") return false;
	const to = document.querySelector(".topbar .stat.gold");
	if (!to) return false;
	const a = from.getBoundingClientRect(), z = to.getBoundingClientRect();
	const x0 = a.left + a.width / 2, y0 = a.top + a.height * .45, x1 = z.left + 12, y1 = z.top + z.height / 2;
	const n = Math.max(4, Math.min(12, Math.round(Math.log2(Math.max(2, gold)) * 1.6)));
	for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
		const c = h("span", {
			class: "coin-fly",
			"aria-hidden": "true"
		});
		c.style.left = `${x0}px`;
		c.style.top = `${y0}px`;
		document.body.appendChild(c);
		const sx = (Math.random() - .5) * 70, up = 50 + Math.random() * 40;
		const anim = c.animate([
			{
				transform: "translate(0, 0) scale(.6)",
				opacity: 0
			},
			{
				transform: `translate(${sx}px, ${-up}px) scale(1.1)`,
				opacity: 1,
				offset: .3
			},
			{
				transform: `translate(${x1 - x0}px, ${y1 - y0}px) scale(.7)`,
				opacity: 1
			}
		], {
			duration: 640 + i * 14,
			delay: i * 35,
			easing: "cubic-bezier(.3,.1,.5,1)",
			fill: "both"
		});
		anim.onfinish = () => c.remove();
		setTimeout(() => c.remove(), 1600);
	}
	return true;
}
/** The building bar's tile for a standing building (`forge` · `kennel` · `bank`): the same panel as the building. */
export function buildingTile(id, o) {
	const t = BUILDING_TILE[id];
	const b = tile({
		id: t.id,
		label: t.label,
		icon: t.icon,
		glyph: t.glyph,
		on: o.on,
		fresh: o.fresh,
		onclick: o.onclick
	});
	b.dataset.building = id;
	return b;
}
/** Cut 30 §3: the bank — deposits earn ~2 % a night, capped at `bank_cap` (the core's); one tap each way. */
export function openBank(app, anchor) {
	openSheet((close) => {
		const body = h("div", { class: "sheet-body bank-sheet" });
		const paint = () => {
			const L = app.lineage, T = L.town;
			if (!T) {
				close();
				return;
			}
			const room = Math.max(0, T.bank_cap - T.bank), put = Math.min(L.gold, room);
			replace(body, h(
				"div",
				{ class: "label row-label" },
				/* copy:label */
				"Savings"
			), h("div", { class: "bank-line num" }, h("b", { class: "gold" }, `$${T.bank}`), " ", h(
				"span",
				{ class: "dim" },
				/* copy:label */
				"saved"
			), h(
				"span",
				{ class: "dim bank-capacity" },
				` · $${T.bank_cap} `,
				/* copy:label */
				"capacity"
			)), h("div", {
				class: "bank-bar",
				"aria-hidden": "true"
			}, h("span", {
				class: "fill",
				style: `width:${Math.round(Math.min(1, T.bank / Math.max(1, T.bank_cap)) * 100)}%`
			})), T.interest > 0 ? h(
				"div",
				{ class: "num dim bank-interest" },
				/* copy:callout */
				`interest $${T.interest}`
			) : "", h("div", { class: "chips bank-acts" }, h(
				"button",
				{
					class: "chip bank-in",
					disabled: put <= 0 || !app.engine.bankDeposit,
					onclick: () => void act(() => app.engine.bankDeposit(put))
				},
				/* copy:button */
				`deposit $${put}`
			), h(
				"button",
				{
					class: "chip bank-out",
					disabled: T.bank <= 0 || !app.engine.bankWithdraw,
					onclick: () => void act(() => app.engine.bankWithdraw(T.bank))
				},
				/* copy:button */
				`withdraw $${T.bank}`
			)));
		};
		const act = async (fn) => {
			if (await app.mutate(
				fn,
				/* copy:callout */
				"bank"
			) && body.isConnected) paint();
		};
		paint();
		return body;
	}, { anchor });
}
/** The tent: the hero — the class, its level and xp (the class picker once classes can be had: the camp's). */
export function openHero(app, anchor, initialTab = "loadouts") {
	let off = () => {};
	let offLive = () => {};
	openSheet(() => {
		const body = h("div", { class: "sheet-body hero-sheet" });
		const tabs = bloodlineTabs(initialTab);
		const identity = () => {
			const L = app.lineage, slot = L.hero_slots?.find((s) => s.id === L.selected_bloodline);
			return JSON.stringify([
				L.selected_bloodline,
				L.heir,
				L.class,
				L.look,
				slot?.hero_name,
				slot?.level,
				slot?.xp,
				slot?.next,
				slot ? heroPresence(slot) : null,
				L.bloodline,
				L.class_styles,
				L.class_tree,
				L.legacy_upgrades,
				L.legacy_respec,
				L.supplies,
				L.starting_kits,
				L.supply_cap,
				L.repeat,
				L.facts,
				L.forge,
				L.town?.home,
				!!L.live,
				L.classes?.[L.class],
				L.hero_legacy?.find((h) => h.heir === L.heir),
				L.runs?.length,
				L.runs?.at(-1)?.id
			]);
		};
		let painted = "";
		const paint = () => {
			tabs.capture();
			painted = identity();
			const historyOpen = body.querySelector(".hero-history")?.open ?? false;
			const paths = body.querySelector(".legacy-tree") ? new Set([...body.querySelectorAll(".legacy-path[open]")].map((el) => el.dataset.branch)) : undefined;
			const classTreeOpen = new Set([...body.querySelectorAll("[data-class-tree-fold][open]")].map((el) => el.dataset.classTreeFold));
			const L = app.lineage, lvl = L.classes?.[L.class] ?? {
				level: 1,
				xp: 0,
				next: undefined
			};
			const slot = L.hero_slots?.find((s) => s.id === L.selected_bloodline);
			const presence = slot ? heroPresence(slot) : null;
			const p = lvl.next === 0 ? 1 : Math.max(0, Math.min(1, lvl.next ? lvl.xp / lvl.next : 0));
			const legacy = L.hero_legacy?.find((x) => x.heir === L.heir);
			const face = h("span", { class: "hero-window-face" });
			paintFace(face, L.class, 72, L.look ?? "");
			replace(body, h(
				"div",
				{ class: "label row-label" },
				/* copy:label */
				`Bloodline ${L.selected_bloodline ?? 1}`
			), h("div", { class: "hero-line num" }, face, h("div", { class: "hero-identity" }, h("b", { class: "hero-name" }, L.hero_slots?.find((s) => s.id === L.selected_bloodline)?.hero_name || L.class), h("div", { class: "hero-class-meta" }, classIcon(L.class, L.class_styles?.selected), L.hero_slots?.find((s) => s.id === L.selected_bloodline)?.hero_name ? h("span", null, L.class) : null, slot ? null : h(
				"span",
				null,
				/* copy:label */
				`Class L${lvl.level}`
			), L.class_styles?.selected ? h("span", { class: "hero-class-path" }, classStyleName(L.class_styles.selected)) : null))), slot ? h(
				"div",
				{ class: "hero-progress num" },
				/* copy:label */
				`Hero L${slot.level}`,
				h("span", { class: "dim" }, slot.next === 0 ? "MAX" : /* copy:label */ `XP ${slot.xp}/${slot.next ?? "—"}`)
			) : null, presence ? h("div", {
				class: "hero-action hero-menu-presence",
				"data-activity": presence.activity,
				title: presence.detail
			}, presence.text) : null, !slot && L.live ? h(
				"div",
				{ class: "dim" },
				/* copy:callout */
				"Hero away"
			) : null, h("div", { class: "hero-actions" }, h(
				"button",
				{
					class: "chip hero-appearance",
					onclick: () => openLooks(app),
					disabled: !app.engine.setLook
				},
				/* copy:button */
				"Appearance"
			), (L.runs ?? []).some((r) => r.id > 0) ? h(
				"button",
				{
					class: "chip hero-runs",
					onclick: () => openRuns(app)
				},
				/* copy:button */
				"Run log"
			) : null), tabs.el, tabs.panel("loadouts", JSON.stringify([
				L.selected_bloodline,
				L.supplies,
				L.starting_kits,
				L.supply_cap,
				L.repeat,
				L.facts,
				L.forge,
				!!L.live,
				L.town?.home
			]), renderBloodlineLoadouts(app)), tabs.panel("class", JSON.stringify([
				L.selected_bloodline,
				L.class,
				L.class_tree,
				L.class_styles,
				!!L.live,
				L.town?.home
			]), h(
				"button",
				{
					class: "chip hero-class",
					onclick: () => openHeroClass(app),
					disabled: !!L.live
				},
				classIcon(L.class),
				/* copy:button */
				"Change class"
			), renderClassTree(app, () => {
				if (body.isConnected) paint();
			}, classTreeOpen), renderClassStyles(app, () => {
				if (body.isConnected) paint();
			}), !L.class_tree || L.class_tree.level < 2 && L.class_tree.spent === 0 ? h(
				"div",
				{ class: "class-tree-soon num" },
				/* copy:label */
				"Class skills",
				L.class_tree?.nodes[0] ? `L${L.class_tree.nodes[0].required_level} · D${L.class_tree.nodes[0].required_depth}` : /* copy:label */ "Skills unavailable"
			) : null), tabs.panel(
				"legacy",
				JSON.stringify([
					L.selected_bloodline,
					L.bloodline,
					L.legacy_upgrades,
					L.legacy_respec,
					!!L.live,
					L.heir
				]),
				h("div", { class: "hero-legacy num" }, h(
					"b",
					null,
					/* copy:label */
					"Legacy"
				), ` ${L.bloodline?.points ?? legacy?.points ?? 0}`),
				// Cut 122 §9: how far to the next rank (`388 / 600 → Health III`) and its bar
				((n) => n ? h("div", {
					class: "legacy-next num",
					"data-price": n.price
				}, h("small", { class: "legacy-next-text" }, legacyNextText(n)), legacyBar(n)) : null)(legacyNext(L)),
				renderLegacy(app, () => {
					if (body.isConnected) paint();
				}, paths)
			), h("details", {
				class: "hero-history",
				open: historyOpen
			}, h(
				"summary",
				null,
				/* copy:button */
				"Details"
			), h("div", { class: "dim num" }, `${legacy?.runs ?? 0} runs · deepest ${legacy?.best_depth ?? 0}`), h(
				"div",
				{ class: "dim num" },
				/* copy:label */
				`Class L${lvl.level}`,
				" · ",
				/* copy:label */
				"Class XP",
				` ${lvl.xp}${lvl.next ? ` / ${lvl.next}` : lvl.next === 0 ? " · MAX" : ""}`
			), h("div", {
				class: "bank-bar xp-bar",
				"aria-hidden": "true"
			}, h("span", {
				class: "fill",
				style: `width:${Math.round(p * 100)}%`
			})), h(
				"button",
				{
					class: "chip hero-chronicle",
					onclick: () => openChronicle(app)
				},
				/* copy:button */
				"Chronicle"
			)));
			tabs.restore();
		};
		paint();
		const refresh = () => {
			if (body.isConnected && identity() !== painted) paint();
		};
		off = app.onChange(refresh);
		offLive = app.onLive(refresh);
		return body;
	}, {
		anchor,
		onClose: () => {
			off();
			offLive();
		}
	});
}
/** A camp panel opened from a building stands over it (its foot on the building's top), or under it when the room above is short. */
export function anchorPanel(panel, anchor, host) {
	const a = anchor.getBoundingClientRect(), r = host.getBoundingClientRect();
	// (only over a building on screen: the well scrolled to its rows leaves the town above, and a panel hung from it would be off screen)
	if (!a.height || !r.height || a.bottom <= r.top + 8 || a.top >= r.bottom - 8 || anchor.hidden) return;
	const above = a.top - r.top, below = r.bottom - a.bottom;
	panel.classList.add("town-anchored");
	if (above >= 220 || above >= below) Object.assign(panel.style, {
		top: "auto",
		bottom: `${Math.round(r.bottom - a.top + 6)}px`,
		maxHeight: `${Math.round(above - 12)}px`
	});
	else Object.assign(panel.style, {
		bottom: "auto",
		top: `${Math.round(a.bottom - r.top + 6)}px`,
		maxHeight: `${Math.round(below - 12)}px`
	});
}
/** dev/test inspection: `window.__town` while a camp stands */
export function exposeTown(ui) {
	const w = window;
	if (!ui) {
		delete w.__town;
		return;
	}
	w.__town = {
		stats: () => ui.view.stats(),
		stress: (n) => ui.view.stress(n),
		setHour: (x) => ui.view.setHour(x),
		actors: () => [...ui.el.querySelectorAll("[data-home-hero]")].map((b) => ({
			id: Number(b.dataset.homeHero),
			rect: ui.view.actorRect(Number(b.dataset.homeHero))
		})),
		targets: () => [...ui.el.querySelectorAll(".town-hit")].filter((b) => !b.hidden).map((b) => {
			const r = b.getBoundingClientRect();
			return {
				id: b.dataset.building,
				x: r.x,
				y: r.y,
				w: r.width,
				h: r.height,
				markers: b.dataset.markers ?? ""
			};
		})
	};
}
/** Class controls belong to the selected hero's menu. */
export function openHeroClass(app) {
	openSheet((close) => {
		const grid = h("div", { class: "classes" });
		const paint = (cat) => {
			replace(grid, ...classList(app.lineage, cat).map(({ cls, owned, level }) => {
				const u = owned ? undefined : cat?.find((x) => x.id === cls);
				return h("div", { class: "class-row" }, h("button", {
					class: `chip${cls === app.lineage.class ? " on" : ""}`,
					disabled: !(owned || u?.available) || !!app.lineage.live,
					onclick: () => void (async () => {
						if (u && !await app.buy(cls)) return;
						await app.setClass(cls);
						close();
					})()
				}, classIcon(cls), cls, ` L${level}`, u?.cost ? ` ◆${u.cost}` : ""), classUnlockReason(u, owned ? undefined : cls), classSkillLadder(CLASS_VERBS[cls] ?? {}, level, owned));
			}));
		};
		paint();
		void app.engine.unlocks().then(paint);
		return h("div", { class: "sheet-body" }, h(
			"div",
			{ class: "label row-label" },
			/* copy:label */
			"Class"
		), grid);
	});
}
